snippets.code:
<script>

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

    const buttons = document.querySelectorAll(
        ".ribbon-btn .elementor-button"
    );

    function activateRibbon() {

        let current = "";

        buttons.forEach(button => {

            const href = button.getAttribute("href");

            if(!href || !href.startsWith("#")) return;

            const section = document.querySelector(href);

            if(!section) return;

            const sectionTop = section.offsetTop - 150;

            if(window.scrollY >= sectionTop){
                current = href;
            }
        });

        buttons.forEach(button => {

            button.classList.remove("active-ribbon");

            if(button.getAttribute("href") === current){
                button.classList.add("active-ribbon");
            }
        });
    }

    window.addEventListener("scroll", activateRibbon);

    activateRibbon();

});

</script>

<style>

html{
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

.ribbon-btn .elementor-button{
    transition: all 0.3s ease !important;
}

.ribbon-btn .elementor-button.active-ribbon{
    background: #f4c400 !important;
    border-color: #f4c400 !important;
}

.ribbon-btn .elementor-button.active-ribbon span{
    color: #000 !important;
}

.sticky-ribbon{
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    z-index: 9999;
}

</style>
